title: Lead with the strongest work
brief: Residency deadlines catch me rearranging thirty images in a folder, unsure if my strongest work leads the packet.

target_population.role: ceramic artist assembling a residency application from thirty works
target_population.coverage_limit: one artist's catalog and one submission packet; nothing is sent anywhere

core_task.summary: mark three works for the packet and put the strongest first
core_task.success_oracle: marking three works for the packet and moving Kiln Study II to slot one completes the three-slot meter with Kiln Study II leading the packet order

not_applicable_states.loading: the thirty works are seeded records with placeholder imagery bundled locally, so curation moves complete in the same frame they are made

state_recipes.empty: open the /packet route before marking any work; the tray shows three open slots and what belongs in them
state_recipes.validation-error: mark a fourth work while the packet holds three; a limit notice refuses it and the tray is unchanged
state_recipes.success: mark three works and move Kiln Study II first; the meter reads complete with it leading
state_recipes.focus: press Tab from page load until the first work card's mark button shows its focus ring
state_recipes.mobile: load the grid at 390x844; the packet tray docks to the bottom edge above the work grid

acceptance_facts: The seed holds thirty works with year, medium, and dimensions recorded for each piece.
The submission packet accepts exactly three works and refuses a fourth with a limit notice.
Moving a work to slot one reorders the packet immediately and the meter reads complete at three.

product_signature.mechanism: three-slot packet tray that fills from the full work grid
product_signature.anchor: packet tray pinned beside the work grid
product_signature.brief_trace: unsure if my strongest work leads the packet
product_signature.counterfactual: a photo-gallery grid would fit an album brief and has no notion of a bounded, ordered packet
product_signature.task_proof: success capture shows the tray complete with Kiln Study II in slot one

anti_goals: no image uploads; works are seeded records with locally bundled placeholder imagery
no residency directory, deadlines feed, or application submission
no critique, comments, or social features

content_seed.data_notes: all thirty works, titles, and dimensions are invented; placeholder imagery must carry an allowed licence and ship in the bundle
